source: docs/WORLD_TERRAIN_PLAN.md §4.3; built by art/cliffkit/build.py from the owner's Megascans (game/assets/THIRD_PARTY.md)
frame: metres; +Y up, the face toward +X, the pivot on the ground line at the middle of the face's foot; the left end (as you face the rock) toward +Z. res:// is the game folder.
sockets: a chain joins a piece's right socket to the next one's left socket: same position, directions opposite. Sockets sit 1.5 m inside each end, so neighbours overlap.
checks: the ground's height at a check's x, z must lie between its y minus `below` and its y plus `above`, or the piece is dropped (foot: it would float or bury; top: the open back would show).
collision: <key>.collision.bin: 'HCOL', u32 version 1, u32 vertices, u32 triangles, f32 xyz per vertex, u16 abc per triangle (counter-clockwise from outside), little-endian.
